source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: When one of these models is destroyed for the first time during a battle round, roll a D6 once that phase ends. On a 2+, put that model back on the battlefield with 3 wounds left, as close as it can be to the spot where it was destroyed while staying outside Engagement Range of every enemy unit. A model can come back like this only once per battle.

trigger.occurrence: first time in a battle round

setBackUp.placement: as close as possible to where destroyed, not within Engagement Range of enemy units
